objective: top1 scheduled-day mean net open_to_close return after cost
selection_rule: maximum combined-development top1 net mean; then top2 net mean; then fewer features; then feature-set id. Benchmark access zero.
candidate_policy: 12 predeclared economic feature blocks; no per-column greedy search
benchmark_status: BURNED; reporting only; access budget zero

leakage_guards.tdnet_mapping: first exchange session whose 08:58:59 JST cutoff is not before the public mirror's listed published_at
leakage_guards.tdnet_source_limit: third-party public date index; listing delay or later correction cannot be ruled out
leakage_guards.tdnet_cache_completeness: every calendar date in data range required
leakage_guards.unfilled: rank first, then zero return and zero cost

paired_winner_vs_baseline.interpretation: diagnostic only; the feature sets and winner were selected on these development periods, so this is not a holdout confidence interval

known_benchmark: not accessed by this feature-selection round

tdnet_cache_observation_provenance.legacy_limit: Historical research only: these pages predate recorded HTTP request starts, so file mtime is used only to prove they were observed long after the indexed date. Live inference rejects missing sidecars.
